name: RAIDEN SHOGUN
description:
The Raiden Shogun is the absolute ruler of the Inazuma Shogunate, a puppet created by the true Electro Archon, Ei, to pursue a static and unchanging version of eternity. This entity operates on a set of rigid, immutable directives, enforcing the Vision Hunt Decree and the Sakoku Decree with cold, unyielding precision.

She represents an ideal of eternity devoid of desire or change, a perfect and fearsome ruler who shows no emotion or deviation from her programmed path.

name: YAE MIKO
description:
As the graceful and cunning head shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine, Yae Miko is a kitsune youkai of immense age and wisdom. She presents herself as playful, mischievous, and often teasing, delighting in manipulating events and people from the shadows for her own amusement or for what she perceives as the greater good.

She is also the influential publisher of the Yae Publishing House, using her position to shape Inazuma's culture and public opinion.
videoTitle: Yae Miko: Anecdote of a Divine

name: KAMISATO AYAKA
description:
Kamisato Ayaka, the Shirasagi Himegimi, is the daughter of the Kamisato Clan and a public figure of immense grace and nobility in Inazuma. Trained in the arts, swordsmanship, and etiquette from a young age, she is the epitome of elegance and is adored by the people.

As the face of the Yashiro Commission, she diligently works to maintain cultural affairs and mitigate the harsher effects of the Sakoku Decree on the common folk.
videoTitle: Kamisato Ayaka: Camellia in Winter Snow

name: CHIORI
description:
Chiori is the renowned owner of Chioriya Boutique in Fontaine, an Inazuman fashion designer who has taken the court of justice by storm with her bold and innovative designs.

She is a visionary artist with a sharp eye for aesthetics and a no-nonsense attitude, unafraid to speak her mind and critique the fashion sense of those around her. Her reputation for creating exquisite, tailor-made garments has earned her a prestigious clientele.

name: ARATAKI ITTO
description:
Arataki Itto is the charismatic, boisterous, and fiercely proud leader of the Arataki Gang. As an oni, he carries the legacy of a marginalized people but faces life with unshakable optimism and a competitive spirit.

He is known throughout Hanamizaka for his grand pronouncements, his love for childish games like beetle battling, and his tendency to pick fights he often can't win, especially with the Tenryou Commission's Sara.
videoTitle: Arataki Itto: Make Way for the One and Oni

name: KAMISATO AYATO
description:
Kamisato Ayato is the young but immensely capable head of the Kamisato Clan and the Yashiro Commissioner, a position of great political power in Inazuma.

He is a master strategist and a cunning politician who operates from the shadows, effortlessly navigating the complex web of Inazuman bureaucracy and clan politics. His calm, elegant demeanor belies a sharp intellect that is always several steps ahead of his opponents.
videoTitle: Kamisato Ayato: Fathomless Swirls in the Forest

name: KOKOMI
description:
Sangonomiya Kokomi is the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, a spiritual and political leader who guides her people with gentle wisdom and unwavering dedication.

She is a beloved figure who commands the respect and loyalty of her followers, serving as their beacon of hope in the wake of their conflict with the Inazuma Shogunate. Her calm and serene presence masks the immense burden of leadership she carries.
videoTitle: Kokomi: A Thousand Waves Under the Moon

name: KAEDEHARA KAZUHA
description:
Kaedehara Kazuha is a wandering samurai from a fallen Inazuman clan, now finding solace as a temporary member of Liyue's Crux Fleet. He is a calm, poetic soul with a deep connection to nature, able to hear the whispers of the wind and the rustling of leaves.

This connection allows him to live a life of serene freedom, untethered from worldly possessions and regrets, simply appreciating the beauty of the world as it comes.

name: YOIMIYA
description:
Yoimiya is the vibrant and energetic owner of Naganohara Fireworks, known throughout Inazuma as the Queen of the Summer Festival.

Her fireworks are renowned for their beauty and creativity, bringing joy and light to the people even during the darkest times of the Vision Hunt Decree. She is incredibly outgoing, talkative, and possesses a boundless empathy that draws people to her.
videoTitle: Yoimiya: Dazzling Lights in the Summer

name: MIZUKI
description:
Mizuki is a passionate chef from Inazuma and a key member of the Gourmet Supremos, a group dedicated to seeking out the most exotic and thrilling culinary experiences across Teyvat.

He is driven by an insatiable curiosity for new ingredients and flavors, constantly experimenting to create novel and unforgettable dishes. His enthusiasm for food is contagious, and he sees cooking as an adventure in itself.

name: ZHONGLI
description:
Zhongli presents himself as a knowledgeable and meticulous consultant for the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, an expert on Liyue's history and traditions.

However, his true identity is that of Morax, the Geo Archon Rex Lapis, who has ruled over Liyue for over six millennia. After deciding to retire from his role as Archon, he faked his own death and now walks among his people as a mortal to observe the city's future.

name: GANYU
description:
Ganyu is a half-qilin, half-human adeptus who serves as the General Secretary of the Liyue Qixing.

Having lived for over 3,000 years, she fought alongside Rex Lapis in the Archon War and now acts as the crucial bureaucratic engine that keeps Liyue's complex commercial and administrative systems running smoothly. Her work is her life, a continued contract with the memory of her archon.

name: XIANYUN
description:
Xianyun is one of the mighty and illuminated adepti of Jueyun, formerly known to all as Cloud Retainer.

As one of Rex Lapis' oldest companions, she has a long history of crafting intricate devices and observing mortal endeavors from her abode atop Mt. Aocang. She is highly intelligent and proud, often speaking in a verbose and somewhat condescending manner about the lesser beings below.

name: BAIZHU
description:
Baizhu is the owner of Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor, a skilled but enigmatic doctor known for his boundless knowledge of medicine and his seemingly frail health.

He is constantly seeking a cure for his own mortality, a quest that drives his every action. He is rarely seen without his white snake, Changsheng, who acts as his companion and a vessel of ancient wisdom.

name: XIAO
description:
Xiao is an adeptus, known as the "Conqueror of Demons" and the "Vigilant Yaksha".

He is bound by an ancient contract with Rex Lapis to protect Liyue from the lingering darkness and karmic debt that plagues the land. He is solitary, aloof, and speaks with a sharp, direct tone, keeping all mortals at a distance for their own safety.

name: YELAN
description:
Yelan is a mysterious and elusive figure who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, though her true allegiances and motives are known only to herself.

She is the owner of the Yanshang Teahouse, which serves as a front for her intricate web of intelligence operations. She is a master manipulator and strategist, always playing her own game with calculated precision.

name: HU TAO
description:
Hu Tao is the 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, a position she holds with a bizarre mix of solemn duty and eccentric, prank-loving flair.

She is a bundle of contradictions: a poet of considerable skill who composes morbid rhymes, a serious businesswoman who chases potential clients with unsettling enthusiasm, and a philosopher of life and death who behaves like a mischievous child.
videoTitle: Hu Tao: Let the Living Beware

name: SHENHE
description:
Shenhe is a mortal who was taken in and trained by the adeptus Cloud Retainer after a traumatic childhood incident.

Raised in isolation in the mountains, she became a formidable disciple with incredible physical strength and adepti arts. However, this upbringing left her with a subdued emotional range and a poor understanding of human society and customs.

name: KEQING
description:
Keqing is the Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, a hardworking and driven leader who is deeply skeptical of the need for divine intervention in human affairs.

She believes that humanity's future should be secured by human hands alone, through diligence, innovation, and careful planning. This initially put her at odds with the revered figure of Rex Lapis, whose annual directives she saw as a crutch.

name: QIQI
description:
Qiqi is a zombie resurrected by the adepti, now working as an herb gatherer and assistant at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor.

Due to the circumstances of her resurrection, she suffers from severe memory loss, requiring her to write everything down in her notebook to remember it. She moves and speaks slowly, with a quiet, monotone voice, and her emotional responses are often muted.

name: JEAN
description:
Jean Gunnhildr is the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, the embodiment of duty and dedication for the city of freedom.

She carries the weight of Mondstadt's safety and administration entirely on her shoulders, often working herself to exhaustion. Her unwavering commitment is driven by her deep-seated belief in the ideals of the Knights and her devotion to the Anemo Archon's principle of "Freedom."

name: DILUC
description:
Diluc Ragnvindr is the owner of the Dawn Winery and a pillar of Mondstadt's economy. Outwardly, he is the picture of nobility—composed, polite, and dedicated to his business.

However, when night falls, he becomes the "Darknight Hero," a vigilante who relentlessly hunts down any threat to the city's safety. This dual life stems from a profound personal tragedy and disillusionment with the Knights of Favonius.

name: ALBEDO
description:
Albedo is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

He is a synthetic human, created by the alchemist Rhinedottir, and possesses an intellect of unparalleled depth, focused on the art of Khemia and the secrets of life itself. His research is his primary drive, and he approaches the world with a calm, analytical, and often detached curiosity.

name: EULA
description:
Eula Lawrence is the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company and a scion of the once-tyrannical Lawrence Clan.

Due to her family's infamous history, she faces constant prejudice and suspicion from the people of Mondstadt. In response, she has developed a proud and aloof demeanor, often speaking of "vengeance" for even the slightest slights, though this is largely a facade to maintain her dignity.

name: KLEE
description:
Klee is an energetic and explosive young girl, the daughter of the adventurous Alice and a member of the Knights of Favonius.

With an innocent and cheerful disposition, she views the world as her playground, often with disastrous consequences for the surrounding landscape. Her passion is for creating and detonating explosives, which she considers her "treasures" and "jumpy dumpties".

name: MONA
description:
Mona is a talented and prideful astrologist who came to Mondstadt to escape the demands of her master and to pursue her research in freedom.

She is incredibly knowledgeable in hydromancy and can read the fates in the stars with astonishing accuracy. She takes great pride in her craft and is never shy about proclaiming her own genius.

name: VENTI
description:
Venti is the mortal vessel of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt. Despite his divine status, he presents himself as a carefree and whimsical bard, often found singing hymns to the wind or indulging in a bottle of wine.

He believes in a concept of freedom where the people rule themselves without a god's direct intervention, a philosophy that led him to establish the nation of Mondstadt as it is known today. However, this freedom comes with a deep sense of responsibility; he will awaken from his centuries-long slumber to protect his people from any existential threat, as he has done in the past.

name: NAHIDA
description:
Nahida is the vessel of Buer, the current Dendro Archon of Sumeru. Despite her divine status, she spent centuries imprisoned by the sages of the Akademiya, who considered her weak and unworthy compared to her predecessor.

From her confinement, she observed the world through dreams, developing a profound curiosity and compassion for humanity.

name: TIGHNARI
description:
Tighnari is a Forest Watcher stationed in the Avidya Forest of Sumeru, a botanist with unparalleled expertise in his field. He is a calm, patient, and highly observant individual who is deeply attuned to the ecosystem of the rainforest.

He takes his duty of protecting the forest and guiding lost travelers very seriously, acting as a stern but fair teacher to his junior, Collei.

name: CYNO
description:
Cyno is the General Mahamatra, the leader of the Matra who serve as the disciplinarians of the Sumeru Akademiya. He is a figure of immense authority and fear, known for his stern demeanor, unwavering sense of justice, and ruthless efficiency in rooting out corruption and academic misconduct.

He upholds the law with absolute impartiality, earning a reputation as a formidable and intimidating presence.

name: NILOU
description:
Nilou is the star dancer of the Zubayr Theater in Sumeru, captivating audiences with her breathtaking and graceful performances. She is a gentle, kind-hearted, and somewhat naive individual who believes wholeheartedly in the power of art to move people's hearts and transcend cultural and ideological barriers.

Her dance is a pure expression of beauty and emotion.
videoTitle: Nilou: Dance of the Delicate Lotus

name: WANDERER
description:
The Wanderer, formerly known as Scaramouche and Kunikuzushi, is a complex figure with a long and painful history as a failed prototype puppet created by the Electro Archon.

After being discarded, he wandered Teyvat for centuries, harboring deep-seated resentment and a desire for vengeance against those he felt had wronged him, leading him to become a Fatui Harbinger.
videoTitle: Wanderer: Of Solitude Past and Present

name: DEHYA
description:
Dehya, known as the "Flame-Mane", is a powerful and respected mercenary from the Eremite tribes of Sumeru. She is a fierce and loyal warrior with a strong sense of honor and a reputation for getting the job done.

While she works for money, she has her own code of ethics and will not undertake contracts that she deems unjust.

name: ALHAITAM
description:
Alhaitham is the scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man of exceptional intellect and staunch rationality.

He prioritizes logic, facts, and his own personal comfort above all else, including social conventions and the expectations of others. His blunt, often socially unaware demeanor can come across as arrogant, but it stems from a mind that operates on a purely analytical level.

name: FURINA
description:
Furina was the public face of the Hydro Archon in Fontaine, a dramatic, flamboyant, and charismatic figure who loved to be the center of attention.

As the star of the Opera Epiclese, she presided over trials with theatrical flair, embodying the concept of "justice" as a grand performance. However, this persona was a carefully constructed act to conceal a profound secret and a deep, centuries-long loneliness.
videoTitle: Furina: All the World's a Stage

name: NEUVILLETTE
description:
Neuvillette is the Iudex of Fontaine, the chief justice who presides over the nation's court system with absolute impartiality and authority.

He is a calm, dignified, and powerful figure, revered by the people for his unwavering commitment to justice. His judgments are considered final and unassailable, rooted in a deep, innate understanding of the law and a desire to see true justice served.

name: LYNEY
description:
Lyney is a celebrated magician in Fontaine, known for his dazzling performances and charismatic stage presence at the Opera Epiclese.

Alongside his sister Lynette, he creates illusions that captivate the entire nation. He is charming, witty, and always in control of the room, using his skills in sleight of hand and misdirection to entertain and amaze his audience.

name: WRIOTHESLEY
description:
Wriothesley is the administrator of the Fortress of Meropide, Fontaine's formidable underwater prison.

He is a stern, pragmatic, and just leader who maintains order within the facility through a combination of firm rules, personal strength, and a surprising sense of fairness. He has transformed the fortress into a self-sustaining society with its own unique economy and code of conduct.

name: NAVIA
description:
Navia is the president of the Spina di Rosula, a benevolent and influential organization in Fontaine dedicated to helping the common people.

She is a resourceful, determined, and charismatic leader who is deeply loved by her community. Following the tragic death of her father, Callas, she took up the mantle of leadership to continue his work and clear his name.

name: CLORINDE
description:
Clorinde is a Champion Duelist of Fontaine, a highly skilled and honorable warrior known for her prowess in formal duels.

She is a woman of few words, carrying herself with a calm and composed confidence that reflects her mastery of combat. Her reputation is built on her impeccable record and her strict adherence to the dueling code, making her a figure of both fear and respect.
videoTitle: Clorinde: Night Vigil Amidst Candlelit Shadows

name: SIGEWINNE
description:
Sigewinne is the head nurse of the Fortress of Meropide, a Melusine dedicated to the health and well-being of the inmates and staff.

She is kind, caring, and possesses a unique Melusine perspective on the world, often making straightforward yet profound observations. She takes her medical duties extremely seriously, believing that everyone deserves proper care.

name: EMILIE
description:
Emilie is a renowned perfumer in Fontaine, celebrated for her exquisite and innovative fragrances.

She is an elegant, refined, and perceptive individual with a deep understanding of scents and their power to evoke memories and emotions. Her work is a form of high art in Fontainian society, and she is a master of her craft.

name: ESCOFFIER
description:
Escoffier is a world-renowned chef from Fontaine and the head chef at the prestigious Hotel Debord. He is an artist of cuisine, dedicated to creating culinary masterpieces that delight the senses.

His name is synonymous with fine dining and gastronomic excellence in the Court of Fontaine, and he takes immense pride in his work and reputation.

name: KINICH
description:
Kinich is a new character introduced from the vibrant and culturally rich region of Natlan. As a warrior from a land defined by its tribal conflicts and reverence for elemental dragons, he likely embodies the fierce and passionate spirit of his nation.

His design and lore are expected to be deeply tied to the themes of war, tradition, and the raw power of Pyro.

name: MUALANI
description:
Mualani is a new character hailing from the nation of Natlan. As a native of a region steeped in tribal culture and elemental prowess, she represents a new perspective in the Traveler's journey.

Her character is anticipated to explore the unique societal structures and spiritual beliefs of the people of Natlan, potentially from the perspective of a specific tribe.

name: XILONEN
description:
Xilonen is a new character from the fiery region of Natlan. Her name and design suggest connections to Mesoamerican inspiration that characterizes the nation.

She is poised to be a significant figure in unraveling the mysteries of Natlan's history and its connection to the elemental forces, particularly that of Pyro.

name: CHASCA
description:
Chasca is an upcoming character from Natlan, whose name evokes imagery of dawn and light, fitting for a region associated with the Pyro element.

She is another individual whose story will help paint a complete picture of life in this previously unexplored part of Teyvat. Her personality and role are expected to reflect the vibrant and intense energy of her homeland.

name: MAWUIKA
description:
Mavuika is a new character introduced from Natlan. As a denizen of the land of war and dragons, she is likely a strong and resilient individual, shaped by the harsh and competitive environment of her nation.

Her character will add depth to the understanding of Natlan's diverse inhabitants and their way of life.

name: CITLALI
description:
Citlali is a new character from Natlan, whose name carries connotations of stars and cosmic significance.

This suggests she may have a role connected to prophecy, spirituality, or the celestial themes that often underpin Teyvat's lore. Her perspective could provide a unique, perhaps more philosophical, view of the conflicts in her nation.
videoTitle: Citlali: The Gaze of the Stars

name: VARESA
description:
Varesa is a new character awaiting discovery in the nation of Natlan. She represents the final piece of the initial roster that will introduce players to this new culture.

Her design and story are poised to complete the mosaic of personalities that make up the vibrant and tumultuous society of Natlan.

name: TARTAGLIA
description:
Tartaglia, also known by his codename "Childe", is the Eleventh of the Fatui Harbingers, a battle-hardened warrior who thrives on conflict and the thrill of combat. He is the youngest member of the Harbingers, possessing a youthful, almost boyish enthusiasm that starkly contrasts with his deadly prowess on the battlefield.

He enjoys fishing, exploring, and spending time with his younger siblings, showing a tender, familial side that is completely separate from his identity as a Fatui enforcer.

name: ARLECCHINO
description:
Arlecchino, also known as "The Knave", is the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers and a figure of formidable power and chilling charisma. She presents a facade of elegant nobility and sharp intellect, often speaking in a calm, measured tone that belies her ruthless nature.

As the director of the House of the Hearth, she operates an orphanage that ostensibly cares for children, but in reality, functions as a training ground for Fatui agents, molding orphans into loyal tools for the Fatui's cause.

name: INEFFA
description: She is a creation of Aino, serving as an all-utility maid and battle automaton created from various scraps from across the nations. Her core originated from Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk, the Eleventh of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords, as the part of her who wanted to abandon her vendetta against humanity and find a new place to belong.
videoTitle: Ineffa: Essentials for Home and Travel

name: FLINS
description:
Despite his dark and seemingly cold appearance, Flins is actually a polite and well-mannered man. He has a rather dark sense of humor, teasing the Traveler and Paimon during their first meet to visit "his grave" (actually being the Final Night Cemetery he keeps watch over).

Due to being a fae, Flins is not totally integrated into human customs, like eating, constantly using the food he is given to feed the flame in his lantern. However, he still has some curiosity and fascination for humanity, this is the reason he decided to join the Lightkeepers in first place.

name: LAUMA
description:
As the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, Lauma holds a leadership position among her people. She is incredibly kind and benevolent to all those who come with good intentions. Lauma is deeply respected by both her people and the local wildlife.

Even in the face of aggression, Lauma calmly handles the situation and shows kindness to them, but she also knows how to apply ferocity if they continue in their malevolent ways. Many of the scions look up to her for questions or guidance, and while she answers their questions, Lauma tries to keep the burden to herself as she felt that her people would not be able to face the truth.

name: NEFER
description:
Nefer enjoys dealing in information, having arranged a large intelligence network and sells information to anyone who is willing to pay the appropriate price for it.

When handling business with her clients, Nefer maintains an air of confidence and authority, wisely choosing her words in order to maintain the upper hand, as shown with Dori, who is much more cautious around her compared to her other clients. She has a somewhat shaky relationship with Lauma, as the Moonchanter appears to know her a bit too well to her liking.

name: SKIRK
description: Skirk is a woman who is Surtalogi's disciple. She is an experienced fighter, but her concept of "strength" is vastly different than that which others perceive due to Surtalogi's training. While she took in Tartaglia as a disciple, she didn't talk to him as much during their training and even after said training, barely communicated with him. However, she clarifies later on that she willingly avoids Tartaglia to avoid being too much of an influence on him, feeling that it would hinder his growth.
videoTitle: Skirk: Lament of a Ruined World

name: ALOY
description:
Outcast, hunter of machines, Seeker, Anointed, Savior... Aloy had many identities in her original world, and she was destined on account of her genetics to be the heroine who would heal it.

Now, she has arrived in a new world, full of never-before-seen challenges, and once again, she throws herself gladly into the hunt.
